reasoning: The question asks whether France's Democracy Index score will decline in 2025 compared to 2024. France is an established democracy with strong institutions, though it has experienced political tensions. The Democracy Index typically shows stability for mature democracies year-to-year, with scores rarely declining significantly unless major institutional changes occur. France would need substantial democratic backsliding to show a measurable decline. While political polarization exists, major authoritarian shifts are unlikely in a single year for an EU member state. Historical precedent suggests stability is more probable than decline.
